newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shop calls boots "Nazi leather".
newsitem.headline: Israeli shop calls boots "Nazi leather".

text.p: An Israeli shoe store owner apologised publicly on Tuesday for marking boxes of shiny black jackboots as "Nazi leather".
"That's what they were called in the professional jargon," Tel Aviv shopkeeper, who identified himself only as Alon, told Israel Radio. "I apologise 1,000 times from the bottom of my heart."

The embarrassed merchant was brought to heel by a front-page story in the Jewish state's biggest selling newspaper, Yedioth Ahronoth, that featured a photograph of a receipt marked "Nazi leather boot".

"We carry two types of boots: shiny leather ones and plain black. For our internal identification of the model we would write on the box 'Nazi black' so that when I went into the storeroom I wouldn't bring the wrong one," he said.
"We used a little tact -- I wouldn't go up to a customer and say 'Listen, this is Nazi leather.'"
